body.name: Gfour
body.def: Let \(V_4=\{01,11,02,12\}\), \(\mathcal B_v=\{0\}\), and \(P_{v,0}=D_v\), where \(D_{01}=\{(a,b):b\le0,a\ge b/2\}\), \(D_{11}=\{(a,b):b\le0,a\le b/2\}\), \(D_{02}=\{(a,b):b\ge0,a\ge0\}\), and \(D_{12}=\{(a,b):b\ge0,a\le0\}\). Set \(\Sigma=\operatorname{diag}(1/8,3/20)\), discrete label metric \(\delta(v,v')=\mathbf1\{v\ne v'\}\), \(\eta=1/20\), and the displayed radius \(r\).
